title: Monderer–Shapley Exact-Potential Characterization
abstract: The full cycle characterization for arbitrary finite player types and arbitrary nonempty player-dependent action spaces. A real-valued exact potential exists if and only if deviators' payoff differences sum to zero around every finite closed path, every finite simple closed path, every simple four-cycle, or every two-player rectangle. The construction uses finite-subset induction and imposes no finiteness restriction on actions. Exact potentials are unique up to an additive constant. With finite actions, the cycle condition yields a pure Nash equilibrium. Adversarial examples distinguish matching pennies, infinite actions, unequal dependent actions, and the finite-action boundary.
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
